summary.headline: TimeX AI: Largest shareholder changes to (유)휴먼데이타 at 35.05% after KRW 3.76bn-share rights issue on Nov 27, 2026
summary.what_happened: On Nov 27, 2026, TimeX AI, Inc.'s largest shareholder changed from the 강성민 group (14.33%) to (유)휴먼데이타, which holds 35.05% after acquiring 3,764,000 new shares through a third-party allotment rights issue (debt-to-equity conversion). The filing states the stake change followed completion of the share payment on that date, and the new shares are subject to a one-year transfer and sale restriction.
summary.why_it_matters: A change in largest shareholder usually signals a shift in control or influence over the company, which can affect management direction and governance. Shareholders in Korea typically review the new holder's background, intentions, and any related-party dealings disclosed in the filing.
